title: breynia rigida var. puberula
intro: Breynia rigida var. puberula, commonly known as the puberulous Breynia or velvet Breynia, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Breynia rigida var. puberula are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity.
